interface: build_sidecars(&Input) -> Result<Output, AdapterFailure>; fixture available as pub(crate) fn fixture() -> Input in the owned test file for the integrated parent pipeline fixture.

implemented.c42_kernels: Calls actual residuals::summarize and metric_cohorts::compare_groups; no oracle values copied.
implemented.logical_outputs: Builds full C0 calibration_residual.v1 and calibration_metric.v1 serde_json::Value records.
implemented.joins: Validates one declared run binding, run/event handles, canonical event:<index>:<generation> causal refs, C0 residual identity, explicit source window, fixed groups/strata, hashes and seed-map v1.
implemented.diagnostics: Retains side-tagged raw residual and metric input records, canonical batch SHA-256 hashes, per-pair probe/event links, window eligibility/exclusion, and C4.2 group populations/counts.
implemented.paired_summary_counts: C0 paired statistic reference_count and simulation_count equal the number of matched pairs used; eligible side counts and unmatched/raw counts remain in group diagnostics.
reviewed_addenda: True observed/predicted points keep their computed exact residual even outside the active source window; C4.2 summary eligibility remains unchanged and the manifest identifies exclusions.
Structural invalid metric cohorts fail before publication with both raw cohorts preserved. Numeric/kernel invalidity can be reported as C0 invalid status with null value.
This adapter admits empirical_equal.v1 only with scale_ticks=1 and nanosecond units; no unreviewed unit conversion is applied.
Event references resolve only through actual EventLogRecord.validate() records keyed by run_id and EventId; null causal_ref means no asserted event link.
